edges.reason: Both sources report the same value (8%) for undergraduate men from the Cornell 2025 survey. The quotes are from different publishers (The Hill and Associated Press).

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes report that 35% of undergraduate women at Cornell reported experiencing sexual assault/nonconsensual sexual contact based on a 2025 survey.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, The Hill reported “Over 35 percent of undergraduate women at Cornell University reported experiencing nonconsensual sexual contact during their time at the Ivy League institution in 2025, according to a poll conducted by the university.”; on 2026-10-06, Associated Press reported “The report said that a 2025 survey found that 35% of undergraduate women and 8% of undergraduate men report experiencing sexual assault during their time at Cornell.”.

On 2026-10-06, Associated Press reported “The report said that a 2025 survey found that 35% of undergraduate women and 8% of undergraduate men report experiencing sexual assault during their time at Cornell.”; on 2026-10-02, The Hill reported “About 8 percent of all undergraduate men reported experiencing a sexual assault while enrolled at the university, according to the poll.”.
